author: vanaukenk
body:
Hi,

As part of the discussions on annotating protein-containing complexes in GO-CAMs, we've agreed that the individual members of the respiratory chain complex II (succinate dehydrogenase) should all be annotated to the MF term succinate dehydrogenase (quinone) activity (GO:0008177) using the 'contributes to' qualifier, rather than 'enables', as none of the individual subunits carries out the reaction in full.

The list of annotations to this MF term (and some to its parent) that need to be reviewed are here:

https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1h0_fUrGRlDKUyy9o1S3gMuN8XiVJW_3vHwIe5aaP250/edit?gid=1194810267#gid=1194810267

Please let me know if you have any questions.  Thanks.
title: Review gp2term relations for succinate dehydrogenase activity terms
